suggested_prompt_or_template_changes: Calibration: keep v6's 'Evidence: decisive|mixed|weak' line and its bands, and stop using the weakest link as the confidence cue. With these tools the deciding variable is almost always unobserved, so v5's definition would make every item low, and the teacher ignored it. Make repeated probability tuples within a school a reject, not a report (two pairs here), and require 'decisive' when the agent itself calls the event small, contained or well-precedented.

Profile (templates.toml, Keynesian diagnosis): replace 'near a zero policy rate ask whether monetary policy can still act or fiscal policy must' with 'only if the policy rate is 1% or lower, ask whether monetary policy can still act; otherwise do not mention the liquidity trap or fiscal substitution'. Replace 'say which dominates' with 'say whether the shock lowers or raises US demand on net and by roughly how much'. Change 'gold follows real rates and stress' to 'gold rises when the event lowers expected real rates or adds stress; a pre-event real-rate level is not a reason'.

ECHO in teacher.py: add 'nothing to reconcile', 'do(es) not contradict', 'nothing in the data contradicts', 'fiscal (need not|is not forced|does not have to)', and '(not|no) (a )?liquidity trap' when the returned policy rate is 2.5% or more. Have the batch report fail when any 5-gram appears in more than 25% of a school's items; the Okun opening and the pre-event disclaimer would trip it.

Step 3: 'If the event states a level, compare it with the data in one clause; never state that nothing contradicts the event.' Add: 'a level cannot show what moved during the event (WTI's level says nothing about this month's energy prices); do not attribute pre-event levels to the event's background (a war premium, a disruption) unless the event says so; read the 2y against the policy rate before saying what the market prices; compare a stated move (bp, %) with the magnitudes in the returned episodes.'

Signals validator. Flag (a) a reason that cites a scenario whose growth/inflation tags point the other way, or a flat/flat scenario (8 items). Flag (b) bonds LONG with inflation-up mass of 0.6 or more (k0003 at 1.00). Flag (c) a directional call on a small or remote event whose reason names only backdrop values: make data-driven calls NEUTRAL instead of 'conviction 2 or less' (k0009 bonds, k0010 gold, k0007 gold). Flag (d) conviction 3 or more resting on under 0.4 once opposite-pointing scenarios are removed (k0010 bonds, k0012 gold). Block, not only report, a batch where one direction exceeds 65% for an asset (bonds 71%, gold 76% here).

Scenarios: reject two scenarios with identical growth/inflation tags (7 items). Define the baseline concretely: 'a scenario in which the event fades, reverses or has no spillover is growth flat, inflation flat'. For 'risk of X' events, require a scenario in which the risk persists without X happening (k0005).

Proof and format: set max_steps=7 in check_v4 to match the prompt (7/17 have 8-9 lines). Reject a final message that does not end with a full stop or whose Confidence line lacks a complete 'weakest link' clause, and check finish_reason (k0012 is truncated).

Episodes: extend the step-2 rule to 'add no cause, mechanism or outcome that the tool text does not state', with one counter-example (EP-1990-08: prices fell when the offensive began, not when supply returned). Before training, run an LLM judge that compares each episode description with the tool text (6 recasts here).

macro_snapshot (items version 5): add a Phillips-curve term so core PCE rises with a positive unemployment gap (6/17 low-unemployment, low-core pairs here). When an event imposes an inversion, lower the 10y rather than lifting the 2y 90bp above the policy rate (k0006). Tell the agent that when unemployment and inflation disagree it must say which it relies on and why, rather than always choosing inflation.

Before training, drop or regenerate k0012 (truncated, UK error) and k0003 (bonds default, liquidity-trap misuse). Repair the opposite-scenario signal reasons and the paradox misuses (k0006, k0016), and strip the 'not a liquidity trap' sentences where the policy rate is 2.5% or more, or regenerate the batch under v6 with the profile edits. Keep the analog triage, the foreign-transmission discipline, the small-event NEUTRALs and the PPI/CPI and 2y checks.
